name: invariant-driven-development
description: A skill for mapping a new product as invariants before anything is planned or built

plugins.name: invariant-driven-development
plugins.description: Map a new product before anything is planned or built: an interview that writes its intent, primitives, capabilities and interfaces under docs/, each a short file of statements that must always hold, with the primitives fixed as the core every build shares, and MADR decision records for why.
